corridor_notes: This is the 黄草峡储气库支干线 (Huangcaoxia gas-storage interconnect branch, one of the 4 major Phase 2 storage-facility branches, distinct from the 8 Phase 3 local supply branches) -- runs entirely within 长寿区 (Changshou District) from 黄草峡首站 (但渡镇) to 云台站 (云台镇), connecting the Huangcaoxia underground gas storage facility to the trunk network. FLAG: the EIA states this branch's total length as 39.24km, but GEM's LengthMergedKm for P7585 is 14.18km -- a significant discrepancy not resolved here. Possible explanations: GEM's figure may cover only a sub-segment of the full 39.24km branch, or the EIA's 39.24km may include compressor-station/lateral piping not counted in GEM's line length, or GEM's figure may simply be outdated/wrong. Flagging per standing rule 3 (don't silently resolve) rather than picking one explanation.
researcher_notes: Both endpoints are named-station matches (not township proxies) with nearby well coordinates, the strongest sourcing among the 7 branch PIDs. Despite the 'Changshou' label matching GEM's ResearcherNotes framing as a Phase-3-style '供气支线' name, this branch is actually one of the 4 Phase 2 (二阶段) storage-facility branches per the EIA's own phase list ('二阶段建设...黄草峡储气库支干线'), not one of the 8 Phase 3 local supply branches -- so unlike the other 6 non-trunk PIDs in this group, the existing 'MZ: ...(二阶段)' ResearcherNotes label is actually ACCURATE for this one. See P7568 for the general Phase 2/Phase 3 labeling note.
blockers: Length discrepancy (EIA: 39.24km full branch; GEM: 14.18km) unresolved -- see corridor_notes.
